newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston, First Data, form venture.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston, First Data, form venture.

text.p: BankBoston Corp and First Data Corp said they formed a joint venture to offer processing and related services to BankBoston's merchant card processing customers.

The announcement said the two companies will each contribute a combination of merchant contracts, sales personnel and marketing resources to the venture in exchange for an equity ownership stake in the new company.
The transaction, which is subject to regulatory approval, is expected to close in the second quarter of 1997, the companies said.

Charles Gifford, chief executive of BankBoston, said in a statement that the venture would be beneficial in two ways. He said BankBoston would maintain a significant stake in a business with "tremendous potential to grow." Second, he said the venture will bring a scale which is necessary for long term success.

With the acquisition of BayBanks in 1996, BankBoston acquired a merchant services portfolio of almost $900 mililon in annual card volume and a service to about 6,000 customers. The announcement said BayBanks executives were already in discussions to create a joint venture with First Data when BayBanks was acquired by BankBoston.
